english: You stand before a wooden board, covered in sketches of various people.
Each of them connected via long red threads.
What's this, Snell?
(Look closer at the sketches.)
E-Interesting.
Hm? He looks over to you from across the apartment.
Ah, yeah. Project visualizer.
Helps me keep track of jobs. You can check it out if you want.
I haven't done much other than a basic outline on the tea shop yet. I've been busy with all this running around.
Looks like... a TON of work.
You're good at this, Snell.
It's messy.
It's not really.
Haven't had that much downtime yet.
...Thanks.
It's what I do.
I know.
Like I said. It's a basic outline. I haven't had that much downtime yet.
Once we're finished, I'll make sure to compile it into a proper report for the Old Lady.
You see several faces you recognize and some you don't.
A bird-man with a black and white pattern. Along with the note, 'TEA SHOP OWNER.'
A bulky merman with the text, 'RIVAL? NO, UNAMBITIOUS.'
A stout-looking dwarf in uniform with a hammer symbol in the corner. 'PATRON?'
A stylish orc with a Freestrider heart symbol in the corner. 'COMPLETELY UNAFFILIATED. SUSPICIOUS.'
A pale man holding a skull. 'NO MOTIVE.'
A human with a fancy beard and a fish symbol in the corner. 'SUPPRESSING INFO. BEWARE.'
Then finally, you look over the central piece. The beautiful rendition of Lady Sageleaf herself.
The sketch is wonderful. A depiction of love.
His devotion is clear in this art-piece.
Her note reads, 'ENEMIES? SPIES? CITY CONSPIRACY?'
